checkedAlternates.risk: Celery grows upright from a basal crown.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The edible celery stalk is an elongated leaf petiole (group-3), not an underground storage bulb (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Artichokes are eaten by peeling green bracts like leaves.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An artichoke is an unopened flower bud (group-1), not vegetative foliage (group-3).
